statement: For direct 1302 IBEX, hid-steam's layered raw client open increments client_opened; work unregisters the kernel's synthetic gamepad and sensor evdev devices asynchronously, 0x42 and 0x45 raw reports forward to clients instead of being decoded to evdev. The final client close permits re-registration; physical HID mouse and keyboard top-level collection input is distinct and not the synthetic evdev pair.
